task: Generate a patch of rolling terrain about 32 by 32 cells and up to 8 tall. Build it with the node graph — generators and transforms — rather than placing voxels yourself, and leave the graph on the project so it can be tuned afterwards.
notes: The method is the point, and it is checkable because the graph travels with the project. An agent can pass the size and voxel bars by hand-placing a thousand cells; only the graph shows it produced something a human can still re-roll and adjust.
